server.name: app.recordo.api/recordo
server.description: Brain dump, routines, task planning, focus, and instant thought retrieval
server.title: Recordo: Task Planner & Notes

examples.description: Quickly capture any idea or note
examples.name: Brain dump a thought
examples.note: Say 'Call dentist next week' or 'Go to gym every Monday and Thursday at 9am' and AI extracts the task with due date

examples.description: See what's on your plate today
examples.name: Check your schedule
examples.note: Ask 'What's on my schedule today?' or 'What do I have tomorrow?'

examples.description: Focus on one thing at a time
examples.name: Get your next task
examples.note: Ask 'What should I do next?' and get the single most important task

examples.name: Find a thought
examples.note: Ask 'What was that idea I had about the presentation?' or 'Show me everything about dentist'

notes: OAuth 2.1 authentication required - users must authorize via Recordo account
Tools: list_entries, add_adhd_note_entry, add_adhd_task_entry, update_entry, delete_entry, complete_task, get_day_summary, get_next_task
Interactive widgets for task cards and daily schedules in supported hosts
Privacy-first: voice recordings and photos are processed and never stored on servers
